disclosureRules.rule: FTC: disclose any material connection (payment, free product, discount); disclosure must be hard to miss and placed with the endorsement, using plain terms like ad or sponsored; the endorser is personally responsible.
disclosureRules.implication: For US readers, a label next to affiliate links and in the video itself, not only a footer or profile.

disclosureRules.rule: Dutch Advertising Code for Social Media and Influencer Marketing (in force since 2022): advertising must be recognisable and relationships disclosed. ACM publishes 2024 online-consumer guidelines (PDF not read). EU UCPD/Omnibus text not opened.
disclosureRules.implication: Label affiliate content as advertising where it appears; the exact ACM and UCPD wording is a gap to close from the primary PDF/directive.
